gloss: reduced working hours; shortened work schedule

definitions.gloss: reduced working hours; shortened work schedule
definitions.explanation: A work arrangement where an employee works fewer hours than the standard full-time schedule. Common for parents of young children, employees returning from leave, or as part of work-life balance policies.

examples.japanese: {時短|じたん}{勤務|きんむ}を{申請|しんせい}する。
examples.english: To apply for reduced working hours.

examples.japanese: {育児|いくじ}のため{時短|じたん}{勤務|きんむ}で{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: I am working reduced hours for childcare.

examples.japanese: この{会社|かいしゃ}では{子|こ}どもが{小学校|しょうがっこう}に{入|はい}るまで{時短|じたん}{勤務|きんむ}{制度|せいど}を{利用|りよう}できる。
examples.english: At this company, employees can use the reduced working hours system until their child enters elementary school.

notes:
USAGE:
A common HR and workplace term in Japan. {時短|じたん} is an abbreviation of {時間|じかん}{短縮|たんしゅく} (time reduction). Legally guaranteed under Japan's Child Care and Family Care Leave Act for parents of children under three.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {時短|じたん}{勤務|きんむ}{制度|せいど} (reduced hours system)
- {時短|じたん}{勤務|きんむ}を{申請|しんせい}する (to apply for reduced hours)
- {時短|じたん}{勤務|きんむ}で{働|はたら}く (to work reduced hours)
- {時短|じたん}{勤務|きんむ}から{復帰|ふっき}する (to return from reduced hours)
